headlines.title: Wall Street’s Wednesday has two tests: the Fed at 2 p.m., then Alphabet and Microsoft
headlines.summary: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Wednesday as investors awaited the Fed decision and chip stocks rose on SK Hynix's record profit
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, yapay zeka modeli ve altyapi yarisinda yeni urun, yatirim veya platform hamlelerinin surdugunu gosteriyor.

headlines.title: Bedrock Robotics nears $1B in total funding as demand for autonomous heavy equipment surges
headlines.summary: Bedrock Robotics has secured $600 million to scale autonomous heavy equipment and combat construction labor shortages.

headlines.title: Visa posted higher quarterly profit as payment volumes and transactions grew
headlines.summary: Revenue rose 13% to $12.14 billion, and the payments company raised its quarterly dividend 16% to 78 cents a share
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, odeme aglari ve stablecoin tarafinda rekabetin sertlestigini ve finans altyapisinda yeni guc dengeleri olustugunu gosteriyor.

headlines.title: Agility and GXO Logistics plan expanded deployment of Digit humanoid
headlines.summary: GXO Logistics, which has tested humanoid robots from multiple companies, will deploy Agility's Digit at two more sites.
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, insansi robotlarin depo ve lojistik tarafinda gercek saha kullanimina gectigini gosteriyor.
